slices.focus: Nadia and Omar move three blocks away to a larger apartment, gaining space and daily routine improvements.
slices.summary: Nadia and Omar move from the duplex above aunt Maha's tailoring shop to a modest larger apartment three blocks away on the West Side. The small-radius move (still close to family) gives them: better parking, enough room for both to move without colliding, and a small desk corner. Nadia plans to buy a lamp first, set up the desk minimally as a 'landing zone' (bills, calendar, reading), and live in the apartment for a month before buying anything beyond basics.
